items.name: FilzaSlop
items.description: FilzaJailedDS fork with container access for iOS 18, iOS 26, and iOS 27 beta 1–4. See README for per-bug status.

items.description: Sandbox escape PoC for iOS 26 and 27

items.name: orbis-pictus
items.description: A tap-to-explore picture book where an AI draws every page in real time — type anything, click anything inside, and it draws a new page about what you clicked. No links, no markup, every pixel made on demand. An open-source homage to flipbook.page.

items.name: Pax-Autocratica-Trainer
items.description: Pax Autocratica trainer and mod menu for PC — god mode, infinite resources, instant build and research, infinite ammo, one-hit kill, max citizen loyalty, unlimited Cores. 50+ cheats across 8 tabs, rebindable hotkeys, read-only mode for Early Access patches. Steam and Epic.

items.name: IRON-NEST-Trainer
items.description: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator trainer and mod menu for PC — auto firing solution, instant traverse, infinite shells, unlock all 30 ammo types and 15 regions, no hearing damage, free camera. 55+ options across 9 tabs. Leaderboard submission blocked by default. Steam, Windows.

items.name: dracavetitle
items.description: 多功能自定义称号插件

items.name: restory-trainer
items.description: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs trainer and mod menu for PC — infinite money, infinite spare parts, instant delivery, no rent, unlock all devices and shop upgrades, freeze the clock, free camera. 55+ options across 8 tabs. Repair-skipping and story-spoiler options tagged and off by default. Steam.

items.name: codex-meme
items.description: A local, context-aware meme reaction layer for Codex Desktop.

items.name: nodeseek-nested-replies
items.description: NodeSeek 楼中楼油猴脚本，支持跨页回复归组

items.name: CHMReader
items.description: 用 Tauri 2 写的 CHM (Compiled HTML Help) 电子书阅读器。直接打开 .chm 文件阅读，保留原书的目录层级和中文标签，不需要先解包到硬盘。  应用名和界面都跟随系统语言：英文系统显示 CHM Reader，简体中文显示 CHM 阅读器，繁体中文显示 CHM 閱讀器。

items.name: HACKATHON-IFTECH
items.description: Repositório dedicado ao desenvolvimento da solução para o desafio do Hackathon IFTECH 2026.

items.name: PaperMeld
items.description: Catalog-first local paper libraries for Codex: organize PDFs and Markdown, retrieve a small evidence set, and keep source files local.

items.name: pi-mobile
items.description: Open-source Flutter Android client for self-hosted Pi Web

items.name: gx10-bench-optimizer
items.description: Model-agnostic LLM benchmarking + tuning in one command. A model is a 15-key profile file. Built in production on a 4x NVIDIA DGX Spark cluster under a live agent workload.

items.name: WorkPilot
items.description: WorkPilot 是一个轻量级纯前端工作助手，帮你一站式管理待办事项、会议、笔记和日报。无需安装、无需后端，双击 HTML 文件即可在浏览器中使用。数据完全保存在本地，支持 JSON 导出备份。暗色科技风设计，护眼又高效。

items.name: telegram-chat-analyzer
items.description: Export Telegram chats and analyze people & activity — weekly matrix, inactivity detection, self-contained HTML dashboard, optional AI narrative. Python/Telethon.
